units.source_text: 站在沙的一方，有形的东西均成了虚无。

en.t: From the standpoint of sand, all things with form had become nothingness.

units.source_text: 确实存在的，只有否定一切形状的“沙的流动”。

en.t: The only thing that truly existed was the flow of sand that denied every shape.

units.source_text: 可是，薄薄的板壁那一边，女人的清沙仍然在持续着。

en.t: Yet on the other side of the thin board wall, the woman was still clearing away the sand.

units.source_text: 用女人纤细的臂膀，究竟能做什么呢？

en.t: What could those slender arms of the woman possibly do?

units.source_text: 简直是拨开水流建房嘛。

en.t: It was like trying to build a house by pushing aside a current of water.

units.source_text: 有些水上倒是可以撑船。

en.t: On some water, though, one could at least pole a boat.
